subject: Auto-match not matching our EUR transactions

messages.name: Globex Corporation admin
messages.body: Auto-match suggests wrong amounts for our JPY account.

messages.name: Priya (Support)
messages.body: This is BUG-2310-01 (Critical, open): on 2.3.1, auto-match does not convert foreign-currency amounts before comparing them. Please match foreign-currency transactions manually for now, and don't bulk-confirm suggested matches on that account. I can't share a fix date, but your ticket is linked and you'll get an email when it ships.
